text:
maria: kicking off a quick bring-up thread for llama2-chat-xl (int8) perf across A100/H100 in us-east / us-west / eu-west. sharing top-line numbers and odd routing tail in us-west.

raj: nice, do you have the single-run artifact or a short summary? :eyes:

maria: summary first then artifact link. low-noise microbench (no caching, steady qps) with concurrency=16. command used:```
./bench --model=llama2-chat-xl --quant=int8 --gpus=H100,A100 --regions=us-east,us-west,eu-west --concurrency=16 --shots=500
```

maria: H100 (us-east): p50 32ms, p95 88ms, p99 170ms, throughput ~420 tok/s
maria: A100 (us-east): p50 38ms, p95 120ms, p99 220ms, throughput ~320 tok/s

maria: H100 (eu-west): p50 36ms, p95 96ms, p99 190ms, throughput ~400 tok/s
maria: A100 (eu-west): p50 42ms, p95 135ms, p99 260ms, throughput ~300 tok/s

maria: H100 (us-west): p50 40ms, p95 320ms, p99 680ms, throughput ~380 tok/s
maria: A100 (us-west): p50 46ms, p95 480ms, p99 980ms, throughput ~250 tok/s

ting: whoa the us-west p95/p99 tails are huge compared to other regions. any network llamas? :neckbeard:

oliver: looks like an extra proxy hop occasionally — our edge-proxy-2 in us-west has been throwing 50-150ms queueing during bursts. I saw similar in the egress logs.

maria: yes, stacktrace from tracing: ``trace: request -> edge-proxy-2 -> pop-proxy -> runtime``. the extra hop correlates with high p95 samples.

raj: curious if KV cache warmup influences it. were these cold prefix runs?

maria: microbench was cold (no caching). i re-ran a warm run (prefix cached) and p95 improved: H100 us-west p95 -> 110ms, A100 -> 160ms. p99 still noisy but far better.

eva: sounds like two problems: (1) edge hop + transient queueing, (2) cold-KV warmup amplification. both add to tail.

oliver: quick mitigation options: route us-west traffic to a different edge-proxy pool (pop-bypass) or enable aggressive prefix caching. can do a canary that pins small percent to pop-bypass.

maria: did a small canary (5%) routing to pop-bypass for 10m: p95 for that slice dropped to ~90ms on H100. full numbers attached in artifact. :rocket:

raj: what about kernel selection / cuops differences? any kernel fallback events recorded when quantized path hit suboptimal kernels?

maria: runtime logs show a handful of kernel fallback falls on A100 int8 path in us-west (rare). H100 int8 path used optimized fused attention almost always. so A100 + proxy + cold cache = worst-case.

ting: can we add automatic routing policy: if p95 > 200ms route to fallback model-variant or different pop?

oliver: yes we have that policy infra. suggestion: make policy evaluate region+p95 over 2m windows and shift 10% to fallback variant (fp16) until p95 normalizes.

maria: added a TODO to the rollout: 1) implement 2m window eval, 2) canary pop-bypass, 3) KV prewarm for chat sessions.

maria: artifact: s3://redwood-test-artifacts/bench/2109876543-llama2xl-int8-snap.html (contains charts: per-region p50/p95/p99, throughput, histograms, and raw traces).

raj: also capture alloc / GPU-mem / kernel occupancy for the runs. might explain throughput delta between H100/A100.

maria: included occupancy dump in artifact and small csv. H100 shows higher SM utilization and smaller kernel latencies.

eva: for customer-facing note: recommend H100 for lowest tail for this model and enable prefix caching + pop-bypass for regulated low-latency SLAs.

ting: will open a short RFC to add pop health metric to the console (p95 by proxy hop) so we can route automatically.

oliver: i'll spin a short remediation patch to prefer fused kernels on A100 when present and fail back faster to fp16 variant if fallback count > 5 in 1m.

maria: thanks all. action items captured:
- maria: docs & artifact link (done)
- ting: RFC for pop-hop p95 metric
- oliver: kernel-fallback mitigation PR
- raj: reproduce with different qps and larger concurrency (32/64)
- eva: short customer note recommending config

deploy-bot: deployment canary started: routing 5% -> pop-bypass at 2026-03-20T15:44:00Z

maria: will monitor and post a quick follow-up in ~30m. :eyes:
